order_item_id.name: order_item_id
order_item_id.meaning: A unique identifier for a specific line item within an order.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.meaning: A reference to the parent order to which this item belongs.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.meaning: A reference to the specific product included in this order line.

table.name: d_tracking_share_transactions__transactions_lots
table.summary: A table recording the association between specific transactions and inventory lots.

transaction_id.name: transaction_id
transaction_id.meaning: Unique identifier for a specific transaction record.

lot_id.name: lot_id
lot_id.meaning: Unique identifier for a specific inventory lot associated with the transaction.

table.name: d_gas_company__company
table.summary: A dataset containing financial and operational metrics for major global companies, including revenue, profits, assets, and market valuation.

company_id.name: company_id
company_id.meaning: A unique identifier for each company record in the dataset.

rank.name: rank
rank.meaning: The global ranking of the company based on a specific metric (likely revenue or market value).

company.name: company
company.meaning: The full legal or trading name of the company.

headquarters.name: headquarters
headquarters.meaning: The country where the company's main office is located.

main_industry.name: main_industry
main_industry.meaning: The primary industry sector in which the company operates.

sales_billion.name: sales_billion
sales_billion.meaning: The total annual sales revenue of the company, expressed in billions of currency units.

profits_billion.name: profits_billion
profits_billion.meaning: The net profit generated by the company, expressed in billions of currency units.

assets_billion.name: assets_billion
assets_billion.meaning: The total value of the company's assets, expressed in billions of currency units.

market_value.name: market_value
market_value.meaning: The total market capitalization of the company, expressed in billions of currency units.

table.name: d_baseball_1__manager_award
table.summary: Records of managers receiving awards in Major League Baseball, including the year, league, and award name.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.meaning: Unique identifier for the manager who received the award, formatted as a short code.

award_id.name: award_id
award_id.meaning: The name or title of the specific award received by the manager.

year.name: year
year.meaning: The calendar year in which the award was given.

league_id.name: league_id
league_id.meaning: The Major League Baseball league (American or National) in which the award was won.

tie.name: tie
tie.meaning: Indicator or note regarding if the award was shared (tied) with another recipient.

notes.name: notes
notes.meaning: Additional textual information or context about the award or the recipient.
